title: Plant-based lunches could cut Australia’s emissions by 15m tonnes, new research shows
summary_full: Nationwide change in lunch habits could cut more climate pollution than grounding every domestic flightGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastAustralians could collectively cut climate pollution by more than 15m tonnes – more than grounding every domestic flight – simply by changing what they eat for lunch.A nationwide shift to plant-based lunches could reduce food-related emissions by 29% – 15.4m tonnes per year – while saving the average household about $611 annually, according to a report by Bryant Research and not-for-profit ProVeg.
